title: Phonon-2 (CoreML) signed-app live ASR
scope: Signed optimized application factory, segmented engine, scheduler and transcript consumer;20ms paced authored PCM
summary: Three warmed holds per supported language; each model downloaded, tested, unloaded and removed before the next. English-only Phonon; English and French for the others.

environment.workload: Normal desktop apps; coordinated serial window with no concurrent native build/model job. Existing swap/desktop pressure retained in per-model context; no concurrent voice qualification.
environment.power_thermal: Per-model power/thermal/load/swap observations retained. Cold preparation is separate from warmed timing.

limitations: One7.25sEnglish/6.65sFrench authored excerpt, three timing trials; not a broad corpus or percentile estimate.
Physical microphone, visible Settings/display, cleanup, insertion, concurrent ASR+voice and M2 hardware are unverified.
First readable provisional text may change; this is not stable-word commitment. Warm timings exclude download, cold graph compilation/load and shape warmup.
Short app final-word scoring is separate from the earlier136/151-word runtime accuracy fixture. Do not relabel earlier accuracy as current full-app quality.
Default selection is the owner-requested PhononEnglish/VozMulti setting; Whistle has the lowest raw French latency in this short app run.
